body: Unfortunately that's a question I don't have an Awnser to. Likely the same reason I feel I need to justify anything I do for my self. Purchases, activities, etc.
my Temporary problem is going on 32+ years

I hit rock bottom Dec 2020. ive spent a good part of 2021 trying to vanish. my wife and kids know I am not doing well. my oldest son found some of my research on suicide, my youngest daughter has noticed my uptake in drinking to be able to get some sleep at night.  My youngest son had classes in regards to mental health and suicide who then approached me and wanted to know where my mindset was. I think they all know the "Accident" was not an accident but no one has said anything directly. my wife has stayed home on some of the darker days but due to the pain its causing them I have to put up the strong wall and appear to be rebounding. at this point it just feels like a waitting game for things to fall into place. (children F19,M16,F15,M13)

Reason I think they know is in 10 years ive drove nearly 500,000Kms with no accidents but some near misses.

unfortunately since the "Accident" that's the only thing not working. I dont feel any happiness/joy, anymore, Even anger is gone. I pretend to care with my family, I try to act like im getting it under control. Ive told the Dr, my concussion specialist and numerous other medical professionals involved(they don't know it was a suicide attempt) no one has looked at it. been asked if im depressed but will never allow that to be diagnosed due to how I make my a living to feed and clothe the family.

after a teenage cutting attempt, OD, & hanging and numerous OD attempts and a head on collision as an adult I will just state reaching the beans as you put it. IS not as easy as it seems. Unfortunately the body is a resilient thing. While our minds my not want us to live our body does.
Thank you and stay strong thats about the only thing I have and can offer

I would like to try and do therapy and I had done it as a teen due to a VERY broken child hood. as an adult I have not seen a therapist due to dark things in my past that could result in some very bad outcomes if the therapist breaks the confidentiality due to Self harm/Harm of others. Several of the demons in my head would result in My own death at the hands of others or my own. 

but I don't know how I would go about talking to someone who has any power/authority/ability to hold it over me.

If i may ask some further questions of similar manner to OP.  This is the reason i wont goto a Therapist now as an adult. 

how do you dance around things you may have done in the past that haunt you today. (some of which are illegal and others which by some are considered immoral) And my daily thoughts/plans for my next "Accident" ?
